description: FAM-01 stock: CalcExpNeeded_STOCK (by exp chart number and level), CalcMoneyRequiredToTrain, CalcExpNeededByRaceClass (Classes/Races ExpTable from the stock database; the chosen ExpTable values are recorded in each case's meta), GetMaxLevel.
notes: Case 'meta' is ignored by the oracle; it carries the ExpTable values the recordsets return so the Rust test needs no database.
CalcExpNeeded_STOCK reports VB errors through HandleError and returns 0; those cases carry an event.
